svg.title: Urban and rural distribution of implementation evidence
svg.desc: The canonical crosswalk identifies 468 urban, 682 rural, and 290 unknown municipalities. Event counts are retained-document distribution, not urban/rural prevalence, and unknown status is not inferred.

g.text: Unknown urbanicity remains visible rather than inferred

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Unit: unique municipality or deduplicated root event • 1,440 municipalities; 2,998 root events • Evidence: descriptive geography

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #6b7280

g.text: No suburban category is created. Unknown urbanicity is preserved and no eligible-universe prevalence is implied.
